scenarios.name: follow-up
scenarios.result:
1. Mountains rise where the earth folds and faults over ages.
2. Snow crowns the highest peaks even in summer.
3. Trails switchback through pine forests before breaking above treeline.
4. Thin air at altitude makes every step deliberate.
5. At dawn, the ridgeline glows long before the valley wakes.
